title: The Spice Merchant Fractional Knapsack
statement:
A spice merchant has a knapsack with maximum weight capacity W. There are N types of precious spices, where spice i has total value V[i] and total weight Wt[i]. Spices can be divided into fractions.

Calculate the maximum total value of spices the merchant can carry. Print the result rounded to two decimal places.
inputFormat:
First line: Two integers N and W.
Next N lines: Two integers V[i] and Wt[i].
outputFormat: Print the maximum value rounded to 2 decimal places (e.g. 240.00).

sampleCases.explanation: Take item 1 (val 60, wt 10), item 2 (val 100, wt 20), and 2/3 of item 3 (val 80, wt 20). Total = 240.
